description:
[narrowed from two-named-capabilities-in-the-goal-host-are-exported-imported-and-never-invoked] Two fully implemented, exported capabilities in goal-host-vessel are imported by src/index.ts and invoked nowhere. The type checker can see both and was never asked.

WHAT IS DEAD, AND HOW IT WAS FOUND. Running the vessel's own tsc with --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters (flags that are NOT enabled fleet-wide) reports 12 unused symbols against a baseline of 0 errors. Two of them are not incidental:

  inferGoalTargetShapes - defined and exported at src/goal-target-inference.ts:87,
  imported at src/index.ts:260, and referenced elsewhere only inside comments
  (goal-target-inference.ts:211, :891 and index.ts:3728). Never invoked. Its
  sibling on the SAME import line, inferGoalTargetDecision, IS used, so the module
  is live and there are two target-inference entry points of which only one is wired.

  decideContinuation - the sole export of src/walk-continuation.ts, declared at :45,
  imported at src/index.ts:276, referenced nowhere else. Never invoked. An entire
  walk-continuation module with no caller.

WHY THIS MATTERS MORE THAN TWO UNUSED IMPORTS. These are not helpers. "Infer the target shapes of a goal" and "decide whether the walk continues" name two of the goal host's core reasoning steps. Anyone reading this vessel to understand how a goal acquires its targets would land on inferGoalTargetShapes and conclude they had found the path. They would be reading code that does not execute. The same is true of walk-continuation for anyone asking how the walk decides to stop.

THIS IS THE SAME CLASS THE SUBSTRATE KEEPS PRODUCING. A mechanism is built correctly, and nothing connects it to a caller: the rhythm registry built and empty; the regionHint consumer complete at low producer coverage; compose-lesson credit wired to the wrong drafter; a learning-signal detector permanently gated by a volume floor its own source cannot clear; enumerated anchor choice implemented only on the path the failures do not take. This is that pattern again, and unlike the others it is visible to a compiler flag rather than requiring a live probe.

NOT A REQUEST TO DELETE THEM. Which way to resolve each is a judgement this gap does not make. inferGoalTargetShapes may be the better of the two inference paths and the wiring may be what is missing; or it may be superseded by inferGoalTargetDecision and should go. Same for decideContinuation. What is not defensible is leaving a named, exported, imported capability that never runs, because it reads as wired to every future reader and to every drafter that greps this file.

VERIFY BEHAVIOURALLY. For each symbol, either a call site exists on an executing path, or the symbol and its now-unused import are gone. Reading the definition proves nothing - the definitions are already there and already correct.

RELATED, AND THE REASON THIS WAS INVISIBLE. noUnusedLocals is not enabled in any vessel. Surveyed 2026-09-10: goal-host 12 violations, ias-executor-ts 19, development-vessel 75, activity-api 159, every baseline 0. Enabling the flags would surface this class permanently, but must follow clearing the existing violations, since enabling first fails typecheck and blocks every compose against that vessel.

src/index.ts(7083,58): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'resolvedShapes'.
src/index.ts(7083,58): error TS2554: Expected 1 arguments, bu
- anchor_not_found: {"error":"old_string not found in file. The closest real text is lines 3726-3731 of 16400, VERBATIM:\n3726: \n3727: // ── Goal→target-shape inference (lever 4, 2026-06-25) ───────────────────────\n372
